Education Loan FAQs What is an Education Loan? An Education Loan helps students fund academic expenses such as tuition fees, books, travel, accommodation, and other study-related costs. ICICI Bank offers loans for domestic and international studies with competitive interest rates and flexible repayment options. Learn more: Education Loan Who can apply for an Education Loan? Any Indian citizen who has secured confirmed admission to a recognised institution in India or abroad is eligible to apply. What is the interest rate of an Education Loan? Interest rates vary based on the type of loan (secured or unsecured), applicant or co-applicant’s profile, institute or college category and type of course. What expenses does an ICICI Bank Education Loan cover? The loan covers tuition fees, travel, examination charges, hostel fees, study materials and other education-related expenses for both domestic and international studies. What are the benefits of choosing an Education Loan from ICICI Bank? ICICI Bank Education Loans offer competitive interest rates, easy repayment options, high loan amounts, instant approvals and more. ICICI Bank also offers doorstep document pickup and online approvals that save your time, making the process smooth and convenient. What expenses are covered? The loan covers tuition fees, exam fees, books, laptop (if required), travel tickets, living expenses, and hostel charges. Is the loan available for foreign studies? Yes. ICICI Bank provides loans for undergraduate, postgraduate, professional, and PhD programmes abroad. How long does it take for ICICI Bank to process an Education Loan application? The ICICI Bank Education Loan processing time can be a few working days after all required documents are submitted. For existing customers, it may be quicker. Delays mostly happen when papers are missing or need verification. What is the ICICI Bank Education Loan disbursement process? The ICICI Bank Education Loan disbursement process begins after all required documents, signatures and bank formalities are completed. This includes submission of admission letters, hard copies and financial documents. Customers can visit the nearest branch or coordinate with their designated relationship manager. Can I take a second Education Loan if my first loan is still active? A second Education Loan may be considered if eligibility criteria are met, co-applicant profile, and total exposure limits as per ICICI Bank norms. What does employment verification in an Education Loan mean? Employment verification involves confirming applicant and co-applicant employment status, income, EPFO account, and financial stability to assess repayment capability for the Education Loan. What should students review and compare when evaluating an Education Loan? Student should compare the interest rate, loan amount, repayment tenure, principal moratorium period, processing fee, foreclosure flexibility, tax benefit availability under Section 80E, collateral requirement, and whether the loan is available for India or abroad studies. These factors help evaluate the overall suitability and repayment burden of an Education Loan. What are the eligibility norms for Education Loans based on academic profile? ICICI Bank states that any Indian citizen who has secured confirmed admission to a recognised institution in India or abroad is eligible to apply for an Education Loan. The bank also notes that interest rates and loan assessment may vary based on the applicant profile, institute category, and type of course.
